title: Hash Heist
summary: A dump of unsalted MD5 password hashes. Crack the admin account.
briefing:
A database breach exposed NebulaCorp's internal account table, which stored passwords as unsalted MD5 hashes — a serious weakness. Incident response recovered the dump (hashes.txt) in "username:md5" format, plus a wordlist of candidate passwords (wordlist.txt).

Your task: crack the password for the "nebula_admin" account.

Not every account's password is in the wordlist (some chose strong passwords), but the admin's is. Use a real cracking tool:

  hashcat -m 0 -a 0 --username hashes.txt wordlist.txt
  john --format=raw-md5 --wordlist=wordlist.txt hashes.txt

Once you recover nebula_admin's plaintext password, submit:
  RANGE{cracked_nebula_admin_<password>}

For example, if the password were "hunter2": RANGE{cracked_nebula_admin_hunter2}
objectives: Run hashcat or John against the wordlist

hints.title: Which account
hints.text: Only nebula_admin matters. Isolate its hash: grep nebula_admin hashes.txt. It is a 32-hex-character MD5.

hints.title: Cracking command
hints.text: hashcat mode 0 is raw MD5. With "username:hash" lines, pass --username. Example: hashcat -m 0 -a 0 --username hashes.txt wordlist.txt --show
